summary: Short kerb beside shops near a junction; homes over 20 m away.
reasons: Only retail 5 m away, homes 23 m+
Plain kerb on a busy street
Just 10 m long, close to junction

drivers.seclusion: Retail building 5 m away (non-residential); nearest dwellings 23 m and beyond, across the road or behind shops.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park along this kerb; the stretch is about one van length and tree-lined near the junction.
drivers.traffic: Whitmore Street carries steady traffic; junction right at the south end.
drivers.convention: Parked cars along the kerb; 4P parallel signs apply 9 am to 7 pm weekdays and Saturday morning only.

flags: Near junction, may fall inside a no-stopping zone
Shop deliveries and morning foot traffic likely
sun_shade: Street trees shade the kerb; shop building shades it from the east in the morning.

best_section.where: East kerb of Whitmore Street, beside the shops just north of the side-street junction
